issues.detail: The current page establishes that 1,600-gallon tanks and 120-foot aluminum booms are offered; the study explicitly combines those supported choices but does not claim a serial-bound factory order.
The current page states SenseApply availability on model-year 2026 machines. This candidate does not include or animate the optional SenseApply camera because its exact model year is unresolved.

The admitted brochure establishes the selected folded overall envelope, but steering angles, boom section lengths, self-centering linkage, suspension travel, breakaway axes, plumbing and nozzle spacing remain unestablished.
